highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: At the University of Massachusetts Lowell (UMass Lowell), you’ll experience a dynamic, hands-on education. UMass Lowell is the largest university in the Merrimack Valley and the second-largest public institution in the state. The university offers you more several degree programmes across six colleges and schools. You’ll find that the university is classified as an R1 institution, indicating very high research activity.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At UMass Lowell, you’ll have so many activities to keep you engaged. You can choose from over 200 active student organisations and connect with peers. Not just that. The university supports you through a comprehensive range of counselling and health services.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You have various on-campus housing options at UMass Lowell. These include a range of residence halls and apartment-style accommodations. Each of these is equipped with modern amenities and located close to the campus.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At UMass Lowell, the library system comprises two main facilities: O'Leary Library on North Campus and Lydon Library on South Campus.

Sports
UMass Lowell offers a wide range of sports facilities to keep you active. You’ll find the Campus Recreation Centre, which is a 65,000-square-foot facility featuring 3 basketball courts, a one-eighth-mile running track, racquetball and squash courts, a 6,500-square-foot fitness area, and multipurpose studios.

Laboratory
UMass Lowell's Core Research Facilities labs have different facilities for a wide range of disciplines. These include labs for materials science, bioengineering, and environmental studies.

Cafeteria
UMass Lowell has various dining options on campus. You can get fresh meals and beverages from the Fox Dining Commons. You can also eat at the South Campus Dining Commons.
